corrections.claim: Every primitive-character rectangle count equals its positive critical-line brackets.
corrections.result: The even mod-5 character has a trivial zero at the origin inside this rectangle. Count 147 equals 146 positive brackets plus the exact origin zero.

corrections.claim: Sum of separately normalized factor means represents the product zero measure up to a common scalar.
corrections.result: Different N_j alter relative root weights. The union mean preserves common multiplicity. All six cutoffs give exact weighted-log-derivative cancellation counterexamples.

corrections.claim: The prime-power coefficient is g log(p), where g counts prime ideals.
corrections.result: It is g*f*log(p), with residue degree f from log(norm(P)); p=5 instead has coefficient log(5).

corrections.claim: Doubling one positive complex-character list supplies the conjugate contribution.
corrections.result: The prior height-reversal correction is now exercised with both certified positive lists and all four factors at matched cutoffs.

corrections.claim: The historical 5–6 ratio is now reconstructed or universal.
corrections.result: Historical quadratic and NPZ inputs are missing. Fresh declared controls vary with T, window, cohort and grid; the old ratio remains withdrawn.

corrections.claim: Finite frequency peaks prove Euler coefficients, density, significance or a natural operator.
corrections.result: Euler identities are proved separately. An explicit formula with controlled tails and a separate statistical design remain required bridges.
